value.rationale: The complete bad-reduction and 31-point-specialization problem is a natural arithmetic invariant of a classical exceptional reflection line arrangement, relevant to how its blowup base locus changes in modular geometry. The all-prime good-reduction criterion is not a mere finite test: the exact determinant norms prove it even at ramified characteristic five, while the singular characteristic-two fiber has a twelve-fold line and eight explicitly quantified collision classes. This is a complete exact structural classification in a motivated sporadic arrangement, without claiming broad consequences such as positive-characteristic Waldschmidt constants.
